content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [company_name]'s site and need some assistance. We are working with [product_name] modules identified by [article_no], and would like to know the correct part numbers for the required PC cable and software. Thank you.

Keep in mind, the USB PC cable only works with USB2 ports. If you have a RS232 (COMx) port, use the PC cable with article number [article_no].
